281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and [[an additional]] adhesive [[layer]], the tool comprising first and second layers and __first and second__ adhesive layer__s__ [[having]] __located on opposite sides of a medial section and each having__ a substantially uniform thickness produced by placing a sheet of adhesive having a substantially uniform thickness between the first and second layers __and the medial section__, __wherein the tool has a circular shape and further includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments mounted to a perimeter of the tool, and a continuous weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments, the plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments being mounted to an outer periphery of the continuous weld ring__.

282. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 wherein the [[additional]] adhesive layer is an epoxy adhesive.

283. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 further including a fiber network between the first and second layers.

284. (Currently amended) The tool of claim283 wherein the fiber network is a random mesh.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 wherein the first and second layers are first and second outer blade cores.

286. (Currently amended) The tool of claim285 wherein the first and second outer blade cores are steel outer blade cores.

287. (Currently amended) The tool of claim286 further including a honeycomb material between the first and second outer blade cores.

288. (Currently amended) The tool of claim286 further including a steel plate between the first and second outer blade cores.

289. (Currently amended) The tool of claim286 further including a fiber reinforced plastic between the first and second outer blade cores, __wherein the continuous weld ring is segmented__.

290. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 further including a honeycomb portion between the first and second layers.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 further including a steel portion between the first and second layers.

292. (Previously presented) The tool of claim291 wherein the steel portion is substantially co-extensive with the first and second layers.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim291 wherein the steel portion includes inner and outer support structures and linear support elements extending between the inner and outer support structures, __and wherein the tool further includes an inner ring coupled to an inner perimeter of the medial section, the inner ring including a central opening__.

294. (Currently amended) The tool of claim281 further including a fiber reinforced plastic between the first and second layers.

295. (Currently amended) The tool claim294 further including a honeycomb portion wherein the fiber reinforced plastic extends on each side of the honeycomb portion, __wherein the continuous weld ring is segmented__.
